# dvls_user_group (Data Source)

A DVLS user group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by ID
data "dvls_user_group" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Lookup by name
data "dvls_user_group" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the user group. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the user group. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the user group.
- `is_administrator` (Boolean) Whether members of the group are DVLS administrators.
- `type` (String) The source of the user group. Possible values are [active_directory, custom, office_365, okta, ping_one].
